$comment: Machine-readable record of what this fork is and how it differs from upstream. Read by downstream consumers that pin an exact engine commit; keep it in step with README.md § Fork divergence from upstream.
attribution: Super Simple Software Factory by IndyDevDan (disler). Forked under MIT; LICENSE and upstream attribution preserved unchanged.

divergences.summary: A run keeps control_root, state_root, target_repo and target_worktree apart instead of deriving one repo_root from the process cwd. A NAMED target_repo must be a checkout root and a NAMED target_worktree must be that repo or one of its linked worktrees (same git common directory); a DEFAULTED root still normalises to its checkout root, so launching from a subdirectory works as before. A state_root that contains a watched root is refused, because everything under the state root counts as runtime and would hide that root entirely. Additive: the defaults collapse to the single-root behaviour.
Every git call takes an explicit cwd and defaults to the process directory, so a workflow can operate on a repository it was not launched from.

divergences.surface: adw_modules/git_helper.py (commit_paths), every ADW with a commit phase
divergences.summary: commit_all() and its `git add -A` are removed with no compatibility shim. A commit phase passes the accepted change set from run.take_changes() to commit_paths(), which refuses paths the repository shows no change to and verifies the landed file set afterwards.

Working-tree fingerprints are '<type>:<git object id>' — content AND file type/mode, so a chmod +x on an already-dirty file is detected. Gitignored files and tracked paths hidden by pre-existing assume-unchanged/skip-worktree flags are watched. Every watched root is fingerprinted, not only the target worktree; does not walk into a wholly-ignored directory. Each Git root also snapshots HEAD attachment, all refs, and exact index bytes so clean self-commits and index-only mutations are detected, restored where safe, and failed. Runtime exemption uses the resolved state_root path, never a same-named relative directory in another repository.

Permission enforcement runs after every agent exit, including agent-process exceptions, malformed-envelope exhaustion, and gate failure. Unauthorized mutations are therefore rolled back before the originating error can leave the phase.

The changed-file gate compares the envelope's claim against the phase's actual target diff in both directions, so an omitted path fails as well as an invented one. The one-directional gate is removed.

Declared artifacts resolve under the run's state root or target worktree; traversal, absolute paths elsewhere and symlink escapes are refused, and an empty artifact list fails artifacts_exist instead of passing vacuously.

Every persisted untrusted string and structured payload is scrubbed and bounded at the one door into the trace: events.name and payload_json, envelopes.payload_json, gate_results.checks_json/violations_json, processes.command, phases.description/error, sessions.request, agent_sessions.model. Join keys (adw_id, phase_id, event_id, session_id, agent and gate names, pid) are left exact so the trace stays queryable.
Adds a stdlib-unittest suite run with `uv run tests/run_tests.py`. No new runtime dependency; upstream had no tests.

control_root and target_repo are watched and denied outright whenever they are a different CANONICAL CHECKOUT from target_worktree, so separating the roots cannot un-protect the factory's own source or a review worktree's trunk, and a factory and trunk that are one checkout are watched once (first label wins). state_root stays the allowed runtime root. Snapshot keys are '<label>::<path>' outside the target worktree. BUILD_NOISE (__pycache__/*.pyc) is exempt in the target worktree only: in a protected root a .pyc is executable Python in a tree no agent may write to, so it breaches and is rolled back.

A relative observability.db resolves against state_root after stripping a leading data_dir prefix, so the shipped default resolves exactly where it always did while a separated state root keeps sssf.db and sessions/ together for the visualizer. An absolute db outside state_root is refused rather than silently escaping.
